comment: ROMtool Class 1 estimating constants (phase 4). EVERY engine constant lives here: factor values, ratios, rates, contingency bands. Nothing is hard-coded in romtool/estimate.py. 'low'/'high' come straight from the catalog factor-row ranges; the engine uses mid = (low+high)/2. Rate card is $/hour, burdened. Contingency is line-risk by catalog source_quality (P published anchors, E estimated/placeholder rows, G guess/practice rows). Edit any value; POST /estimates also accepts a rate_overrides block that deep-merges on top of this file per estimate.

rate_card.rate_notes: Burdened rates (wages + payroll burden + vehicle/small tools allowance). Foreman rate also bills the N02 non-working supervision hours (super/PM labor class). I05 Project management is a percent of accepted labor (pm_pct), not hours.

contingency_note: N05 Class-1 carry, line-risk based not blanket (catalog note); E placeholder rows carry more than P published rows, G rows most. Applied per line to its labor dollars, never mark-up dollars.

occupied.note: Occupied-building productivity: +25-50% zone hours in live areas.

constrained_access.note: Freight elevator / parking / escort constraints: +20-40% affected hours.

ladder.note: Ladder work above 12 ft (Durand difficult column): +15-25%.

lift.note: Elevated-work factor (K03 difficult..very-difficult); boom/MEWP zones default at the difficult end unless very_difficult applies.

scissor.note: Scissor lifts position faster than boom lifts: easier end of K03.

rope.note: Rope-access (rappel) penalty vs ground-level same task: +50-100%.

access_note: Access methods map to catalog factor rows: ground=none, ladder=K06, lift/scissor=K03, rope=K05. The access factor is NOT applied to K-Access-ADDERS minute rows themselves (K01/K02/K04/K07/K08/K10/K11/K13 are already access-specific adders); condition and schedule factors still apply to them.
foreman_note: N01 working-foreman mechanics: a working foreman produces at ~50% while supervising, so a crew of T techs + F foremen delivers T + F*0.5 effective techs; foreman hours carry at foreman_rate.

supervision_pct.note: Non-working supervision (super, PM) labor: 8-15% of direct labor hours, billed at foreman_rate.

idle_lockout.note: Blacked-out windows carry idle crew-day cost (schedule risk, not hours): crew_size x hours_per_day x blended rate, blended = (techs*tech_rate + foremen*foreman_rate)/crew_size.

power_plant.note: O-zone auto-sizing helper: Ah = runtime_hours x load_amps; strings = ceil(Ah / battery_string_ah) (IFC 510.4.2.3 12-hr sizing per O04 notes). Rectifiers auto N+1: qty = ceil(load_amps / rectifier_size_amps) + 1 unless the block pins rectifier_modules.

derived_note: Derived estimate-level logistics lines (M05 travel moves, N03 orientation, N04 cleanup) carry base minutes with NO factor stacking (they ARE the wrap); location-level power-plant derived lines stack normally.

crew_week_basis.note: Crew-day capacity = crews x (techs + foremen) x hours_per_day; crew-week capacity adds days_per_week. crew_days = ceil(direct wrapped hours / crew-day capacity) drives the N04 cleanup qty.
